Software" in Yahoo and Google and came across your web site and email address.  

Our May editorial focusing is Statistical Software, and I thought you would you be

http://www.scimag.com or in one of our bi-monthly email newsletters?

messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to impute a small trial dataset in Amelia-Gauss.  Everything works 
fine until Stage 4 when I get the following error message:


******************************************
* Stage 3 of 4: Importance Sampling...  
******************************************

   10   20   30   40   50
Got  1, resampling...
Got  3, resampling...
Got  5, resampling...

******************************************
* Stage 4 of 4: Imputing Data Sets... 
******************************************

   -3
ERROR in command:Can't update.  Database or object is read-
only.

ERROR in command:Can't update.  Database or object is read-
only.                                                                           
                                                                                
                                                      
    2   -3
ERROR in command:Can't update.  Database or object is read-
only.                                                                           
                                                                                
                                                      
    3   -3
ERROR in command:Can't update.  Database or object is read-
only.                                                                           
                                                                                
                                                      
    4   -3
ERROR in command:Can't update.  Database or object is read-
only.                                                                           
                                                                                
                                                      
    5

           *********************
              Amelia Complete   
           *********************

I've checked the "Properties" of my files, and they are not read-only.  Does 
anyone have any advice?

Thanks very much,

Lily Tsai
Ph.D. candidate
Department of Government
Harvard University
